_comment: CloudEvents 1.0 stress example — the envelope's less common corners at once: every OPTIONAL context attribute (subject, time with fractional seconds, datacontenttype, dataschema), a base64-encoded binary payload in data_base64 instead of data, and vendor extension attributes (traceparent, tracestate, partitionkey, sampledrate) that detection and normalization must carry through.
